info.title: DAB Observations & Measurements REST API
info.description:
The DAB O&M REST API eases the discovery and access of observation data. It is designed to be compliant with OM-JSON OGC DP 15-100r1 and GeoJSON.

## Authentication

**Users registered in Keycloak** call the operations under *Keycloak users (bearer token)*, sending a Keycloak access token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (no token in the path):

* in this page, press **Authorize** and log in with **keycloak** (OAuth2, authorization code with PKCE): the token is then sent with every *Try it out*;
* from scripts, obtain a token with the requests under *Access token for scripts (device login)* and paste it in **bearerToken**, or send it in the `Authorization` header.

Access tokens expire after a few minutes: scripts refresh them with the `refresh_token` grant. An invalid or expired token is refused with HTTP 401.

**Users with a personal token** (registered before Keycloak) keep calling the operations under *Users with a personal token in the path*, with their token in the path.

post.description:
Returns a `user_code` and a `verification_uri_complete`: open that URL in a browser, log in and approve. Then request the token (step 2) with the returned `device_code`, waiting `interval` seconds between attempts.

Add the `offline_access` scope to get a refresh token which survives the browser session (long running scripts).

post.summary: 2. Get or refresh the access token

400.description: `authorization_pending` (the user has not approved yet: retry after `interval` seconds), `slow_down`, `expired_token`, `access_denied` or `invalid_grant`

example.error_description: The authorization request is still pending
